english.note: Use this colloquial phrase when someone goes back to an earlier place or position rather than merely stepping backward.

exampleSentences.english: It is too dangerous here, so let us retreat to the entrance and wait.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢度太危險，我哋退返去門口等啦。
